newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns Ba2 to Skylark's long-term debt.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Ba2 to Skylark's long-term debt.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday it had assigned a Ba2 rating to the senior unsecured long-term debt of Skylark Co Ltd, a restaurant chain operator in Japan.
Moody's said in a statement it is the first time it has rated the debt of the company.
The rated securities are Skylark's 10 billion yen 2.75 percent domestic bonds due 2001, and its 10 billion yen 3.0 percent domestic bonds due 2002, Moody's said.
The ratings recognise Skylark's strong market position in the family-oriented restaurant market due to its diversified outlets and established brand name, Moody's said.
